premises.text: Demand for home security is high but adoption is low because incumbent systems are hard to install, non-portable, over-alerting, and decor-obtrusive
premises.evidence_span: while the majority of Americans, including myself, want to have home security, less than 20% of us actually do

premises.text: An all-in-one self-install unit with camera, motion, and environmental sensors plus mobile app gives home monitoring in minutes
premises.evidence_span: an all-in-one solution to know and control your home from one single destination

premises.text: Customizable themes and control of connected devices (Nest, Hue, Wemo) extend beyond basic alerts
premises.evidence_span: given you the ability to connect and control different devices, including your Nest, Philips Hue light bulb, and a Belkin Wemo smart switch

premises.text: Portable design targets urban dwellers and pet parents who move frequently
premises.evidence_span: we've seen two segments that really popped, which is the urban dweller market as well as pet parents

premises.text: Hardware-as-platform monetization includes cloud video/media services and Android developer apps on the device
premises.evidence_span: our business is really one of hardware as a platform, where the Sentry unit is just a beginning. We'll also be offering cloud video recording and media archiving services

domains.name: urban pet segments and platform services

value.text: Simple, elegant home monitoring and control that protects what matters most
value.evidence_span: monitoring and control for the modern home to help protect what matters most

causal_links.evidence_span: the solutions that are available today are both broken and outdated
simple, that was elegant and intelligent, and that was really designed for life
having that portability and being able to take this solution on to go with them

notes: Install complexity/portability/false alerts/decor folded as one incumbent-failure pain bundle. Camera/motion/env sensors + self-install treated as one hub mechanism; themes and third-party device control kept as personalization/control extension of the hub. Kickstarter sales and $299 price excluded as traction/ask. Taipei/SF footprint treated as ops biography not a theory condition.
